The '''ThrustMaster 9000 aerospike rocket engine''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] designed and produced by [[Galactic Power Engineering/Legends|Galactic Power Engineering]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
The ThrustMaster 9000 was a type of [[rocket engine]] designed by Galactic Power Engineering for use in their [[GPE-3130 Podracer/Legends|GPE-3130]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]. A pair of these [[Engine/Legends|engines]] were bolstered by a pair of smaller [[Ramjet/Legends|ramjets]] on nacelle-mounted outriggers. Providing the primary thrust for the Podracer, were so power that the Podracer did not handle turns well.<ref name="EV" />
